answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the pearl of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The gale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pigment.
